description: Each ranked candidate uses its enclosing named invocation and its actual prefix bindings before admission (engine §2.1 and §6.1).
grammar:
%ambiguity-resolution late-elision
%rule text ((X $x:a ($y:b ≻ c)) ≻ z) %conditions $x.source-text = $y.source-text

%rule a Q
%rule b (Y Z)
%rule c (Y Z)
%rule z (X Q Y Z)
